# `prefer-replace-scalar`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a pointer-capture loop that replaces every element equal to one scalar.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`std.mem.replaceScalar` states the complete in-place replacement operation
directly.

## When it fires

The loop must contain only one equality test and assignment through the captured
element pointer, using simple scalar expressions.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn replace(values: []u8, old: u8, replacement: u8) void {
    for (values) |*value| {
        if (value.* == old) {
            value.* = replacement;
        }
    }
}
```
